Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Intervening Spirit
Cards.Text: Battle: Even if this unit is not at the current battlefield, if any enemy units are there, target your Personality: Move him there. Straighten him if he moved. If he is an Ancestor and this Shugenja is Water, you may take an additional Battle action.

Cards.Name: The Earth Flows
Cards.Text:
After you gain Honor from destroying an army in battle resolution, if this Shugenja is Earth and in the winning army: Gain 2 Honor.
Battle: If you are the Defender, target a Personality: Move him to the current battlefield. Straighten his unit if he moved.

Cards.Name: Winds of Dismissal
Cards.Text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and target another player's Personality: If he is dishonorable, Kolat, Ninja, or Shadowlands, his controller loses Honor equal to his base Personal Honor. If this Shugenja is Air, gain 1 Honor.
